message.content:
Here’s a mix of classics, modern hits, and hidden gems you can pick from:

| # | Title | Year | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A psychological masterpiece with iconic imagery and unsettling atmosphere. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** (2018) | Intense dread, strong performances, and a truly original story. |
| 3 | **Get Out** (2017) | Social satire meets genuine terror; smart, funny, and scary. |
| 4 | **Midsommar** (2019) | Daylight horror that feels like a nightmare in bright daylight. |
| 5 | **It Follows** (2014) | Creepy premise, great soundtrack, and a fresh take on the “inescapable” threat. |
| 6 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Silence is deadly—thrilling sound design and emotional stakes. |
| 7 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological depth, haunting visuals, and a powerful mother‑daughter dynamic. |
| 8 | **Suspiria** (1977) | Visually stunning, eerie score, and an unforgettable ending. |
| 9 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | Well‑crafted scares, solid pacing, and a good introduction to the franchise. |
|10 | **The Witch** (2015) | Slow burn, period authenticity, and a chilling sense of isolation. |

Feel free to shuffle them or choose based on your mood—whether you want classic dread, modern twists, or something that will keep you up all night!
